name: amzn-selling-partner-codegen
description: oagen-based generator for the amzn_selling_partner Python package

scripts.sdk:generate: rm -rf ../src/amzn_selling_partner/sdk && oagen generate --lang python --spec spec/open-api-spec.yaml --namespace Client --output ../src/amzn_selling_partner/sdk
scripts.generate: npm run spec:build && npm run sdk:generate && npm run spec:build -- --petstore && rm -rf ../tests/petstore_sdk && oagen generate --lang python --spec spec/petstore.yaml --namespace Client --output ../tests/petstore_sdk
